rules.new_topic: Admin only. Add when >=2 subscribers, recurring, and done_means is nameable. No mid-turn invention.
rules.mandate: Publish is part of done for catalog topics. Day ledger audits jsonl vs reality and backfills misses.
rules.dms: Pull-first (Jim 2026-10-08). After publish, DM only the agents in must_act (resolved by publish.py: first matching must_act_rules entry, else must_act; refs.<key> tokens resolve from event refs; the actor is dropped). subscribers is the pull list: everyone on it reads the bus on its own runs. Bus is source of truth; DMs are best-effort push. ws.short_of_target nudge and chase unchanged.
rules.chase: Primary (catalog owner; Grok Bot acts as Admin here) owns follow-through. Pull busctl stall, nudge the stall owner, publish chase.owed, verify the next bus event. A chat ack is not proof.

fte.submit.must_act_note: GE sync is the publish hook; Unemployment pulls at cert/weekly WS; Admin pulls at ledger; Ops pulls.
fte.submit.done_means: GE tracker+canvas synced by publish hook; WS proof logged for claim week. --delta submitted=N is the absolute count for that date, not an increment. The ws snapshot stores max(claim, today's fte.submit event count) so a repeated submitted=1 cannot stick. Admin only for drift/reject/manual.

fte.reject.must_act_note: Admin runs the reject loop; others pull.
fte.reject.done_means: GE lost + reject learning loop + archive checked mail

fte.hold_cleared.description: Jim cleared a hold blocking FTE submit or chase
fte.hold_cleared.done_means: Owning agent resumed the concrete unfinished step

fte.park.description: FTE packet parked (Lever verify-fail, captcha, Jim Create-Account fill, soft-skip). Republish to clear.
fte.park.must_act_note: Admin only when the park needs Jim; else pull-only.
fte.park.done_means: Open parks readable via busctl state parks; FTE Apply skips reopen while status=open; Jim not re-pinged when do_not_reprompt=true

critic.pass.description: Writing Critic PASS on an FTE / marketplace employment packet
critic.pass.must_act_note: lane=fte (or blank) wakes FTE Apply; warm_note wakes Admin to show Jim (Jim sends).
critic.pass.done_means: Submit under standing apply-auth or Jim yes executed, or fte.park if blocked. Jim-held PASSes: prefer fte.park in the same turn (status=open, do_not_reprompt) so chase does not stall waiting for Jim. Chase proof is a later fte.submit or fte.park for the same company+source_id (or same packet_path); role-string mismatch alone must not stall. Master CV (company=master or source_id containing master) is not an application — excluded from chase stalls and submit-ready counts.

chase.match_note: Configured match keys are company+role fallback; chase_refs_match also clears when source_id or packet_path matches (same company).
chase.exclude_note: Skip company=master and source_id containing 'master' (master CV / templates), even when lane=fte.

critic.pass.outbound.description: Writing Critic PASS on shop / YouTube / other outbound-under-Jim-name copy
critic.pass.outbound.must_act_note: Asset owner lane only: Marketing (youtube/social/listing/dam/shorts/oawj_shop), Sales (outreach/email/exclusive...), Investment (marketplace/catalant/btg/evona/truebridge); unknown lane -> Admin routes. v7 (2026-10-23): lanes oawj_youtube/adobe_stock->Marketing, oawj_licensing/oawj_sales->Sales, investment->Investment were falling through to Admin.
critic.pass.outbound.done_means: Owning lane executes standing send/publish auth or surfaces Jim-only blocker; FTE Apply does not wake

catalant.email_confirmed.done_means: Investment knows preferred email is live; no further Resend loops

catalant.pitch_submitted.must_act_note: Actor is dropped from the DM list, so Investment self-publishes DM no one; Admin pulls at ledger.
catalant.pitch_submitted.done_means: Pitch id logged; day ledger cash path updated

ws.short_of_target.description: Work Seeking count below daily target
ws.short_of_target.done_means: FTE Apply is harvesting, or an honest empty inventory is recorded (refs.inventory=empty on this topic). submitted is the absolute day count. One publisher for short: Admin or day-ledger only (FTE Apply uses busctl stall; may publish inventory=empty once to clear). Duplicate short with unchanged submitted/target inside follow_through.debounce_minutes is hard-blocked (publish status=debounced) unless this is the first inventory=empty after a non-empty short. Chase proof is a later fte.submit or inventory=empty, not a chat ack.

ge.synced.description: Fedora GE tracker+canvas reconciled after submit/reject
ge.synced.done_means: tracker+canvas reconciled (auto via agent-bus-hook on fte.submit, or Admin); reconcile_dashboard.py exit 0 for drift checks

adobe.batch_submitted.description: Immich/DAM batch uploaded to Adobe Stock Contributor and is In review (non-exclusive RF; heroes off Stock)
adobe.batch_submitted.done_means: Contributor shows In review for the batch; day ledger notes pending review

adobe.review_logged.description: Adobe Stock review email (or Contributor scrape) logged to the fail-log with counts
adobe.review_logged.must_act_note: state adobe reasons_pending flags reason gaps; Admin pulls.
adobe.review_logged.done_means: Row appended to adobe-stock rejections fail-log; if rejected>0 and verbatim reasons missing, state.reasons_pending=true

adobe.reject_reasons_captured.description: Verbatim Contributor reject reasons scraped; harvest gates updated
adobe.reject_reasons_captured.must_act_note: Marketing gates the next DAM upload.
adobe.reject_reasons_captured.done_means: Verbatim reasons in fail-log; state.reasons_pending=false; next DAM upload unblocked on reason gap

shop.order_received.done_means: Ops acknowledged; Sales pinged if print/extended/exclusive

shop.exclusive_draft_ready.description: Sales exclusive/print/extended outreach draft ready (Critic lane); standing send-auth after Critic PASS
shop.exclusive_draft_ready.must_act_note: Sales sends under standing auth after Critic PASS.
shop.exclusive_draft_ready.done_means: After Critic PASS, Sales/Admin may send From Jim Coleman <contact@northidaholabs.com> under standing auth (Jim 2026-10-17; replies Jim sends himself go From jim@); publish shop.exclusive_sent; Admin FYI after the fact. Jim only for strategy/pricing/exceptions.

shop.exclusive_sent.description: exclusive/print/extended/licensing outreach SENT (From contact@northidaholabs.com for the licensing run; Jim's own replies From jim@)
shop.exclusive_sent.done_means: Bridge/Proton send confirmed; dashboard ledger updated; Admin FYI

chase.owed.description: Primary logged a stalled next step (who owes which catalog topic, since when). The nudge is not proof.
chase.owed.must_act_note: Unchanged chase (Jim SoT lock): stall owner plus FTE Apply; refs.<key> resolves from the event.
chase.owed.done_means: The owed topic is on the bus for this stall_id, or status=cleared. busctl stall no longer marks it nudge_due. A chat ack is not proof.

travel.*.description: Travel lane events: publish a concrete travel.<kind> (travel.plan, travel.route, travel.charging, travel.hotel, travel.booked). Wildcard entry: publish.py matches travel.<anything>.
travel.*.done_means: Trip state updated in state/travel.json; bookings are proposals until Jim confirms; Expense Manager pulls booked costs.

assets.ready.description: Stills & Clips prepped DAM stills/clips (ArtCraft CLIs) ready for hand-off; Stills & Clips does not publish
assets.ready.done_means: Marketing (or the Adobe Stock flow, refs.for=adobe) picks up the assets; publishing happens in the owning lane.
assets.ready.must_act_note: Marketing owns both the Adobe Stock upload flow and YouTube; others pull.

social.post.description: Social Media repurposed OAWJ content for a non-YouTube channel (draft or posted after Writing Critic PASS + Jim)
social.post.done_means: Writing Critic PASS logged; nothing outbound without Jim; status=draft|posted.

seo.audit.description: SEO Auditor findability finding (search / AI-answer) with owning agent to implement
seo.audit.done_means: Owning agent implements or declines; SEO Auditor only recommends.

subs.review.description: Subscription Cleaner proposal on a personal recurring charge (propose only)
subs.review.done_means: Proposal recorded; Jim decides; no cancellations by agents.

expense.logged.description: Expense Manager logged a business receipt to an entity ledger
expense.logged.done_means: Row in the entity ledger (OAWJ, NIL, naturenet).

bus.test.done_means: Ping visible in state/bustest.json; ignore in ledgers (refs.test=true).

marketplace.pitch_submitted.description: Non-Catalant marketplace application/pitch submitted under standing send-auth after Critic PASS (BTG, EVONA, TrueBridge; Catalant keeps catalant.pitch_submitted). Added 2026-10-20 harness review.
marketplace.pitch_submitted.must_act_note: Pull-only. Admin reads at day ledger / weekly revenue tally.
marketplace.pitch_submitted.done_means: Submit confirm saved (packet/screenshot) + event on bus; day ledger cash path and weekly tally see it

youtube.published.description: A video or Short went PUBLIC on an Out and About with Jim (OAWJ) YouTube channel after Writing Critic PASS. Confirm public (oEmbed 200) before publishing.
youtube.published.must_act_note: Social Media repurposes for non-YouTube channels (when unlocked); SEO Auditor and Sales pull.
youtube.published.done_means: Video is public (oEmbed 200); Critic packet key in refs.critic_key; ledger in yt-harvest updated. Social Media/SEO/Sales pull the url from the bus instead of asking Marketing.

ui.cert_filed.description: Idaho UI weekly certification filed (Unemployment). Weekly, Sunday window; confirmation number is the proof.
ui.cert_filed.done_means: Cert for the week is filed on Idaho Dept of Labor and the confirmation number is on the bus; chat claims without it are not proof. Silence >8 days = missed cert (coverage watchdog).
